name: Fettucine alfredo
assumptions: Yield of 4 servings based on standard pasta recipe proportions (250g dry pasta typically serves 4).
Total time of 20 minutes estimated from instruction steps: sauce prep ~5 min, pasta cooking ~4 min, combining ~5-10 min.
Vegetarian: true as all ingredients are plant- or dairy-derived with no meat.
Vegan: false due to clotted cream, butter, and Parmesan cheese.
Pescatarian: true as compatible with vegetarian diet and no meat/flesh.
Gluten-free: false due to wheat-based fettuccine pasta.
Dairy-free: false due to clotted cream, butter, and Parmesan.
Milk: true from dairy ingredients (clotted cream, butter, Parmesan).
Wheat: true from fettuccine (durum wheat pasta).
Eggs, Fish, Shellfish, Tree nuts, Peanuts, Soy, Sesame: confidently absent based on listed ingredients.
Corn flour treated as cornstarch (no wheat); parsley, nutmeg, and black pepper (mentioned in instructions but not listed) introduce no additional allergens or diet conflicts.
No compound sauces or ambiguous items; all ingredients classified conservatively per listed items only.
instructions:
In a medium saucepan, stir the clotted cream, butter and cornflour over a low-ish heat and bring to a low simmer. Turn off the heat and keep warm.
Meanwhile, put the cheese and nutmeg in a small bowl and add a good grinding of black pepper, then stir everything together (don’t add any salt at this stage).
Put the pasta in another pan with 2 tsp salt, pour over some boiling water and cook following pack instructions (usually 3-4 mins). When cooked, scoop some of the cooking water into a heatproof jug or mug and drain the pasta, but not too thoroughly.
Add the pasta to the pan with the clotted cream mixture, then sprinkle over the cheese and gently fold everything together over a low heat using a rubber spatula. When combined, splash in 3 tbsp of the cooking water. At first, the pasta will look wet and sloppy: keep stirring until the water is absorbed and the sauce is glossy. Check the seasoning before transferring to heated bowls. Sprinkle over some chives or parsley, then serve immediately.

ingredients.assumptions: Standard clotted cream values used; high-fat dairy product with negligible fiber.

ingredients.name: Butter
ingredients.assumptions: Unsalted butter; essentially pure fat with trace carbs and protein.

ingredients.name: Corn Flour
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tsp cornflour (cornstarch) estimated at 3g; typical thickener values, fiber is low but present.

ingredients.name: Parmesan Cheese
ingredients.assumptions: Hard grated Parmesan cheese; high protein, moderate fat, low carbs.

ingredients.name: Nutmeg
ingredients.assumptions: Grated nutmeg estimated at 2g (typical small amount for a recipe); high in fiber relative to carbs.

ingredients.name: Fettuccine
ingredients.assumptions: Dry fettuccine pasta; standard uncooked durum wheat values, as cooked weight would require unlisted water absorption.

ingredients.name: Parsley
ingredients.assumptions: Chopped parsley estimated at 10g (typical garnish amount for 4 servings); low-calorie herb with fiber.
